messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build "FinTrack" (Personal Money Manager) — an offline-first personal-finance PWA (React+TS+Vite+Dexie frontend, Django+DRF backend, Neon PostgreSQL).
- Current task: complete the production UI/UX redesign in one shot — every page plus login/register — and integrate the frontend with the exact route architecture the user specified, adding/fixing any missing features in one undivided pass.

## Requirements
- Phase workflow: inspect → explain → implement → lightweight checks → inspect diff → report → stop. Do not auto-continue into unrelated phases; do not auto-commit/push.
- Prioritize implementation over exhaustive testing; only basic sanity checks (typecheck, build, lint).
- Do NOT run `python manage.py migrate` automatically; generate with `makemigrations`, user runs `migrate`.
- Do not rewrite working backend functionality; do not invent APIs. If a feature isn't implemented, prepare UI architecture without pretending it's functional.
- **Lucide React is the mandatory standard icon library** — no emoji UI, no hand-drawn SVGs, no other icon libs; centralized icon registry; `aria-label` on icon-only buttons; consistent stroke width and Tailwind sizing (`h-4/h-5/h-6`); semantic icon mapping; category icons stored as identifiers resolved via a registry — never render arbitrary user-provided components.
- Centralized design system with semantic tokens; no hardcoded colors in components; dark mode preserving semantic meaning; reduced-motion support; accessible forms/keyboard nav.
- Offline-first: React → state/query → Dexie/IndexedDB → sync queue → Django REST → Neon. Reports/budgets/calendar must work offline.
- Distinguish Income / Expense / Transfer semantically; never break accounting logic (transfer ≠ income/expense).
- No giant empty states ("No accounts yet." alone is forbidden — always icon + explanation + action).
- Desktop sidebar + mobile bottom nav with central "+" quick-add; responsive at 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920.
- Monorepo: `web/`, `api/`, `shared/`. Deploy: frontend→Vercel, backend→Render, DB→Neon, attachments→Cloudinary.
- No secrets in commits; never commit `.env`.
- **User's mandated route architecture (verbatim, must be honored):**
  - PUBLIC: `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password/:token`, `/verify-email`, `/mfa`
  - MAIN: `/` → redirect to `/overview`; `/overview`; `/accounts`, `/accounts/new`, `/accounts/:accountId`, `/accounts/:accountId/edit`; `/transactions`, `/transactions/new`, `/transactions/:transactionId`, `/transactions/:transactionId/edit`; `/categories`, `/categories/new`, `/categories/:categoryId/edit`; `/budgets`, `/budgets/new`, `/budgets/:budgetId`, `/budgets/:budgetId/edit`; `/statistics`; `/calendar`; `/goals`, `/goals/new`, `/goals/:goalId`, `/goals/:goalId/edit`; `/debts`, `/debts/new`, `/debts/:debtId`, `/debts/:debtId/edit`; `/credit-cards`, `/credit-cards/new`, `/credit-cards/:cardId`, `/credit-cards/:cardId/edit`; `/recurring`, `/recurring/new`, `/recurring/:recurringId`, `/recurring/:recurringId/edit`; `/installments`, `/installments/new`, `/installments/:installmentId`, `/installments/:installmentId/edit`; `/search`; `/bookmarks`; `/notifications`; `/sync/conflicts`
  - SETTINGS: `/settings`, `/settings/profile`, `/settings/security`, `/settings/appearance`, `/settings/notifications`, `/settings/currency`, `/settings/financial`, `/settings/sync`, `/settings/data`, `/settings/devices`, `/settings/about`
  - "integrate the frontend with these routes, if there are missing features fix and add it do it all in one task don't divide it"
- User asked: "change app.tsx also to the integration you've placed on the writing" — App.tsx must be rewritten to this route table.

## Decisions
- **Client-side analytics engine**: all report/statistics/budget/calendar/net-worth figures computed from Dexie via pure functions so offline reporting is real.
- `savings_goal` and `debt` nullable FKs on `Transaction` (migration `finance/0003_...`, generated not applied).
- Sync protocol: `M2M_FIELDS = {"transaction": {"tags": Tag}}`, `ALLOWED_FIELDS["transaction"]` includes `tags`, `recurring_id`, `installment_id`, `savings_goal_id`, `debt_id`; `FK_FIELDS` gained `recurring`, `installment`, `savings_goal`, `debt`.
- `LocalAttachment.blob: Blob | null` (blob URLs don't survive reloads); attachments excluded from sync ENTITY_MAP (Cloudinary, online-only) by design.
- Preferences live in `meta` key `preferences` as one JSON blob — device-level.
- `useLocalData()` is the single read path: `useLiveQuery` per table + memoized `buildLookups()`.
- Tailwind palette stays CSS-variable-driven (`.cjs` config required; jiti caches config).
- Auth context owns full auth surface; router routes everything else.
- Auth screens use split-screen `AuthLayout` (branding panel only `lg`+).
- Money Manager philosophy over enterprise dashboard aesthetic; information-dense but calm, few large cards, progressive disclosure.
- `/` renders nothing and redirects to `/overview`; `isActive()` special-cases `/overview` instead of `/`.
- `/conflicts` renamed to `/sync/conflicts` per user architecture.
- Bottom nav = 4 primary items + central FAB (`grid-cols-5`: items[0], items[1], FAB, items[2], items[3]); Statistics reachable via sidebar/drawer only.
- `PRIMARY_NAV` = Overview, Transactions, Accounts, Budget, Statistics; `PLANNING_NAV` = Goals, Debts, Credit cards, Recurring, Installments, Calendar; `ORGANISE_NAV` = Categories, Search, Bookmarks; `SETTINGS_ITEM` exported separately; `AUTH_ROUTES` + `isAuthRoute(pathname)` for full-bleed auth rendering.
- `/categories/new` and `/categories/:categoryId/edit` are routed overlays (URL reflects state, browser Back closes them) — pattern repeated for all other `new`/`edit` sub-routes.
- `AccountDetailPage` and `AccountEditor` serve both `/accounts/:accountId` and `/credit-cards/:cardId` (params read via `accountId ?? cardId`) — same ledger detail, only section chrome differs.
- `AccountEditor` keys `AccountFormOverlay` by id so switching rows remounts rather than carrying stale fields.
- Debts page explicitly alerts that debts are not income/expense; repayments are transfers.
- Recurring rule pages project future occurrences locally via `advanceOccurrence()` rather than reading a generated table (correct offline).
- Design-system gaps fixed rather than worked around: `ProgressBar.className`, `Textarea.addon`, `Spinner`/`PageLoader` barrel exports; `SegmentedControl` has `size`/`className`/`ariaLabel`, `SegmentOption` has `icon?`/`tone?`; `Input` has no `suffix` — use `trailing`.

## Work State

### Completed
- **Phases 1–5 (earlier)**: scaffold/CI, users+audit apps, 11 finance models + services + ViewSets, Dexie schema/repositories/auth stub/routes, full sync engine, conflicts page, themed Tailwind config.
- **Backend full pass**: MFA, ProfileView, ChangePasswordView, session revocation, `purge_user`, TOTP, attachments (Cloudinary), notifications, recurring/installment generation, budgets, FX, all reports, CSV import/export, django-q2 jobs, management commands, admin, sanitized `.env.example`.
- **Redesign Phase A (design system)**: `lucide-react`, `dexie-react-hooks` installed; `src/index.css` semantic tokens + dark overrides; `tailwind.config.cjs`; `src/design/icons.ts`; `src/design/format.ts`; `src/components/ui/` (Button, Input, Overlay, Primitives, Feedback, Controls, Toast, Charts, PageHeader, Spinner, barrel).
- **Redesign Phase B (data layer + analytics)**: `db/types.ts`, `db/index.ts`, `db/repositories.ts`, `sync/mapping.ts`, syncEngine tag_ids fix, `features/analytics/{period,fx,engine,search,useLocalData}.ts`, `features/settings/preferences.ts`, `app/navigation.ts`, SyncIndicator, ThemeToggle, AppShell.
- **Redesign Phase C — auth**: AuthContext full surface; `AuthLayout`, `LoginPage`, `RegisterPage`, `ForgotPasswordPage`, `ResetPasswordPage`, `VerifyEmailPage`.
- **Syntax/type fixes earlier this session**: `TransactionsPage` missing `useMemo` paren; `OverviewPage` missing `}`; design-system gaps; null-narrowing via re-bound consts (`active`, `tx`); unused imports removed.
- **Feature pages written**: `TransactionList.tsx`, `TransactionForm.tsx`, `QuickAddSheet.tsx`, `OverviewPage.tsx`, `AccountFormOverlay.tsx`, `AccountsPage.tsx`, `AccountDetailPage.tsx`, `TransactionsPage.tsx`, `TransactionDetailPage.tsx`, `CategoryEditor.tsx`, `CategoriesPage.tsx`, `ConflictsPage.tsx`.
- **New pages written this segment**: `budgets/BudgetEditor.tsx`, `budgets/BudgetsPage.tsx`, `goals/GoalEditor.tsx`, `goals/GoalsPage.tsx`, `debts/DebtEditor.tsx`, `debts/DebtsPage.tsx`, `accounts/AccountEditor.tsx`, `creditCards/CreditCardsPage.tsx`, `recurring/RecurringEditor.tsx`, `recurring/RecurringPage.tsx`, `recurring/RecurringDetailPage.tsx`.
- **Navigation/shell integration**: `navigation.ts` rewritten for mandated routes; `AppShell.tsx` updated (`/sync/conflicts`, `SETTINGS_ITEM`, `end={!item.matchNested}`, corrected `BottomNav`).
- `AccountDetailPage` param routing updated to accept `accountId ?? cardId`.

### Active
- Still being written (not yet created): `StatisticsPage`, `CalendarPage`, `InstallmentsPage` + `InstallmentEditor` + `InstallmentDetailPage`, `SearchPage`, `BookmarksPage`, `NotificationsPage`, `SettingsPage` (+ 10 sub-sections), `MfaPage`, `BudgetDetailPage` (`/budgets/:budgetId`), `TransactionDetailPage` `/edit` wiring.
- `src/App.tsx` still contains the old prototype (top-nav + inline login form, default imports of pages that no longer have default exports) — must be replaced with the full route table (user explicitly requested).
- `src/main.tsx` not yet updated with `ToastProvider`/`PreferencesProvider`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Write remaining feature pages: installments (list/editor/detail), statistics, calendar, search, bookmarks, notifications.
2. Write `SettingsPage` with nested `/settings/*` sub-sections (profile, security, appearance, notifications, currency, financial, sync, data, devices, about), `MfaPage` at `/mfa`, and `BudgetDetailPage`; extend `ResetPasswordPage` to read `:token` from path params instead of query.
3. Replace `src/App.tsx` with the full route table (named exports, `/` → `/overview` redirect, `isAuthRoute` gating for public routes, `new`/`edit` routed overlays, `/credit-cards/:cardId` → `AccountDetailPage`/`AccountEditor`), update `src/main.tsx` providers, delete `src/App.test.tsx` and stale `src/sync/SyncStateBadge.tsx`.
4. Run `npx tsc --noEmit`, then `npm run build` and `npm run lint` in `web/`; fix fallout.
5. PWA: manifest, service worker, registration, SVG icon, install + update handling, offline banner ("Offline — your changes are saved on this device and will sync automatically").
6. Run `api/_smoke_all.py` once more on SQLite to verify sync M2M/FK additions, then delete the throwaway script.
7. Remind the user to run `python manage.py migrate` in `api/` (pending migrations incl. new `finance/0003`; not applied by design).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build "FinTrack" (Personal Money Manager) — an offline-first personal-finance PWA (React+TS+Vite+Dexie frontend, Django+DRF backend, Neon PostgreSQL).
- Current task: complete the production UI/UX redesign in one shot — every page plus login/register — and integrate the frontend with the exact route architecture the user specified, adding/fixing any missing features in one undivided pass.

## Requirements
- Phase workflow: inspect → explain → implement → lightweight checks → inspect diff → report → stop. Do not auto-continue into unrelated phases; do not auto-commit/push.
- Prioritize implementation over exhaustive testing; only basic sanity checks (typecheck, build, lint).
- Do NOT run `python manage.py migrate` automatically; generate with `makemigrations`, user runs `migrate`.
- Do not rewrite working backend functionality; do not invent APIs. If a feature isn't implemented, prepare UI architecture without pretending it's functional.
- **Lucide React is the mandatory standard icon library** — no emoji UI, no hand-drawn SVGs, no other icon libs; centralized icon registry; `aria-label` on icon-only buttons; consistent stroke width and Tailwind sizing (`h-4/h-5/h-6`); semantic icon mapping; category icons stored as identifiers resolved via a registry — never render arbitrary user-provided components.
- Centralized design system with semantic tokens; no hardcoded colors in components; dark mode preserving semantic meaning; reduced-motion support; accessible forms/keyboard nav.
- Offline-first: React → state/query → Dexie/IndexedDB → sync queue → Django REST → Neon. Reports/budgets/calendar must work offline.
- Distinguish Income / Expense / Transfer semantically; never break accounting logic (transfer ≠ income/expense).
- No giant empty states ("No accounts yet." alone is forbidden — always icon + explanation + action).
- Desktop sidebar + mobile bottom nav with central "+" quick-add; responsive at 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920.
- Monorepo: `web/`, `api/`, `shared/`. Deploy: frontend→Vercel, backend→Render, DB→Neon, attachments→Cloudinary.
- No secrets in commits; never commit `.env`.
- **User's mandated route architecture (verbatim, must be honored):**
  - PUBLIC: `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password/:token`, `/verify-email`, `/mfa`
  - MAIN: `/` → redirect to `/overview`; `/overview`; `/accounts`, `/accounts/new`, `/accounts/:accountId`, `/accounts/:accountId/edit`; `/transactions`, `/transactions/new`, `/transactions/:transactionId`, `/transactions/:transactionId/edit`; `/categories`, `/categories/new`, `/categories/:categoryId/edit`; `/budgets`, `/budgets/new`, `/budgets/:budgetId`, `/budgets/:budgetId/edit`; `/statistics`; `/calendar`; `/goals`, `/goals/new`, `/goals/:goalId`, `/goals/:goalId/edit`; `/debts`, `/debts/new`, `/debts/:debtId`, `/debts/:debtId/edit`; `/credit-cards`, `/credit-cards/new`, `/credit-cards/:cardId`, `/credit-cards/:cardId/edit`; `/recurring`, `/recurring/new`, `/recurring/:recurringId`, `/recurring/:recurringId/edit`; `/installments`, `/installments/new`, `/installments/:installmentId`, `/installments/:installmentId/edit`; `/search`; `/bookmarks`; `/notifications`; `/sync/conflicts`
  - SETTINGS: `/settings`, `/settings/profile`, `/settings/security`, `/settings/appearance`, `/settings/notifications`, `/settings/currency`, `/settings/financial`, `/settings/sync`, `/settings/data`, `/settings/devices`, `/settings/about`
  - "integrate the frontend with these routes, if there are missing features fix and add it do it all in one task don't divide it"
- User asked: "change app.tsx also to the integration you've placed on the writing" — App.tsx must be rewritten to this route table.

## Decisions
- **Client-side analytics engine**: all report/statistics/budget/calendar/net-worth figures computed from Dexie via pure functions so offline reporting is real.
- `savings_goal` and `debt` nullable FKs on `Transaction` (migration `finance/0003_...`, generated not applied).
- Sync protocol: `M2M_FIELDS = {"transaction": {"tags": Tag}}`, `ALLOWED_FIELDS["transaction"]` includes `tags`, `recurring_id`, `installment_id`, `savings_goal_id`, `debt_id`; `FK_FIELDS` gained `recurring`, `installment`, `savings_goal`, `debt`.
- `LocalAttachment.blob: Blob | null` (blob URLs don't survive reloads); attachments excluded from sync ENTITY_MAP (Cloudinary, online-only) by design.
- Preferences live in `meta` key `preferences` as one JSON blob — device-level.
- `useLocalData()` is the single read path: `useLiveQuery` per table + memoized `buildLookups()`.
- Tailwind palette stays CSS-variable-driven (`.cjs` config required; jiti caches config).
- Auth context owns full auth surface; router routes everything else.
- Auth screens use split-screen `AuthLayout` (branding panel only `lg`+).
- Money Manager philosophy over enterprise dashboard aesthetic; information-dense but calm, few large cards, progressive disclosure.
- `/` renders nothing and redirects to `/overview`; `isActive()` special-cases `/overview` instead of `/`.
- `/conflicts` renamed to `/sync/conflicts` per user architecture.
- Bottom nav = 4 primary items + central FAB (`grid-cols-5`); Statistics reachable via sidebar/drawer only.
- `PRIMARY_NAV` = Overview, Transactions, Accounts, Budget, Statistics; `PLANNING_NAV` = Goals, Debts, Credit cards, Recurring, Installments, Calendar; `ORGANISE_NAV` = Categories, Search, Bookmarks; `SETTINGS_ITEM` exported separately; `AUTH_ROUTES` + `isAuthRoute(pathname)` for full-bleed auth rendering.
- `/categories/new` and `/categories/:categoryId/edit` are routed overlays — pattern repeated for all other `new`/`edit` sub-routes.
- `AccountDetailPage` and `AccountEditor` serve both `/accounts/:accountId` and `/credit-cards/:cardId` (params read via `accountId ?? cardId`).
- `AccountEditor` keys `AccountFormOverlay` by id so switching rows remounts.
- Debts page explicitly alerts that debts are not income/expense; repayments are transfers.
- Recurring rule pages project future occurrences locally via `advanceOccurrence()`.
- Design-system gaps fixed rather than worked around: `ProgressBar.className`, `Textarea.addon`, `Spinner`/`PageLoader` barrel exports; `SegmentedControl` has `size`/`className`/`ariaLabel`, `SegmentOption` has `icon?`/`tone?`; `Input` has no `suffix` — use `trailing`; `BadgeTone = neutral|primary|income|expense|warning|info` (**no `danger` or `success` — Alert shares this set**); UI `Charts.SeriesPoint = {label, value, secondary?, meta?}` (no `key`/`income`/`expense`/`net`); `SearchInput` prop is `onValueChange` (not `onChange`), takes `aria-label`.
- **`paramId()` helper** (`web/src/app/routeParams.ts`): `new` is a create route, not an id — all routed editors rebind their param through it so `/things/new` doesn't try to load a record.
- **MFA**: LoginPage no longer has inline OTP; on `mfa_required` it stashes `{email,password}` in sessionStorage (`fintrack_mfa_pending`) via `stashMfaCredentials()` and navigates to `/mfa`; `MfaPage` finishes sign-in and clears the stash; opened with no stash it shows "Back to sign in".
- **Notifications**: REST-only resource cached in Dexie (`db.notifications`); endpoints `GET /notifications/`, `POST /notifications/{id}/read/`, `POST /notifications/read-all/`, `POST /notifications/checks/`. Device-level filters `notifyBudgets/Debts/Goals/Other` added to Preferences and applied in `NotificationsPage`.
- **No `/fx/rates/` endpoint exists** — exchange rates are synced rows (`/exchange-rates/`); `CurrencySection` offers manual rate add/delete only (no invented refresh API).
- **Register gap fixed in backend**: `RegisterSerializer` now accepts `full_name` (split into first/last) and `preferred_currency`; `UserProfile` frontend type changed from `full_name` to `first_name`/`last_name`, plus `profileName()` helper.
- CSV export/import are real endpoints: `GET /transactions/export/` (raw fetch + blob download) and `POST /transactions/import_csv/` with `{csv, dry_run}`.
- Settings layout = `SettingsPage` with sub-nav + `<Outlet />`; each section its own file; shared `Panel`/`ToggleRow` in `features/settings/Panel.tsx`.
- `ResetPasswordPage` reads `:token` from path params (falls back to `?token=`), `uid` still from query.
- Appearance "Motion" panel reads real `matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")` state instead of a fake toggle.
- Deleted stale files: `src/App.test.tsx`, `src/sync/SyncStateBadge.tsx`.

## Work State

### Completed
- **Phases 1–5 (earlier)**: scaffold/CI, users+audit apps, 11 finance models + services + ViewSets, Dexie schema/repositories/auth stub/routes, full sync engine, conflicts page, themed Tailwind config.
- **Backend full pass**: MFA, ProfileView, ChangePasswordView, session revocation, `purge_user`, TOTP, attachments (Cloudinary), notifications, recurring/installment generation, budgets, FX, all reports, CSV import/export, django-q2 jobs, management commands, admin, sanitized `.env.example`; RegisterSerializer name/currency fix (this session).
- **Redesign Phase A (design system)**: `lucide-react`, `dexie-react-hooks` installed; `src/index.css` semantic tokens + dark overrides; `tailwind.config.cjs`; `src/design/icons.ts`; `src/design/format.ts`; `src/components/ui/` (Button, Input, Overlay, Primitives, Feedback, Controls, Toast, Charts, PageHeader, Spinner, barrel).
- **Redesign Phase B (data layer + analytics)**: `db/types.ts`, `db/index.ts`, `db/repositories.ts`, `sync/mapping.ts`, syncEngine tag_ids fix, `features/analytics/{period,fx,engine,search,useLocalData}.ts`, `features/settings/preferences.ts`, `app/navigation.ts`, SyncIndicator, ThemeToggle, AppShell.
- **Redesign Phase C — auth**: AuthContext full surface (+`first_name`/`last_name`/`profileName()`), `AuthLayout`, `LoginPage` (rewritten, no inline OTP), `RegisterPage`, `ForgotPasswordPage`, `ResetPasswordPage` (`:token`), `VerifyEmailPage`, **`MfaPage` created**.
- **All feature pages written**: TransactionList/Form/Editor/QuickAddSheet, OverviewPage, AccountFormOverlay, AccountsPage, AccountDetailPage, AccountEditor, TransactionsPage, TransactionDetailPage, CategoryEditor, CategoriesPage, ConflictsPage, BudgetEditor/BudgetsPage/BudgetDetailPage, GoalEditor/GoalsPage/GoalDetailPage, DebtEditor/DebtsPage/DebtDetailPage, CreditCardsPage, RecurringEditor/RecurringPage/RecurringDetailPage, InstallmentEditor/InstallmentsPage/InstallmentDetailPage, StatisticsPage, CalendarPage, SearchPage, BookmarksPage, NotificationsPage (+`features/notifications/repository.ts`), and **all 11 settings files**: `SettingsPage.tsx`, `Panel.tsx`, `OverviewSection`, `ProfileSection`, `SecuritySection`, `AppearanceSection`, `NotificationsSection`, `CurrencySection`, `FinancialSection`, `SyncSection`, `DataSection`, `DevicesSection`, `AboutSection`.
- **`app/routeParams.ts` created**; `paramId` wired into BudgetEditor, GoalEditor, DebtEditor, RecurringEditor, InstallmentEditor, AccountEditor, CategoryEditor, TransactionEditor.
- **`src/App.tsx` fully rewritten** to the mandated route table (named exports, `/` → `/overview`, `PublicRoutes`/`MainRoutes` split, `isAuthRoute` gating, `new`/`edit` routed overlays, `/credit-cards/:cardId` → AccountDetailPage/AccountEditor, nested `/settings` with index route, `QuickAddSheet` mounted with `?add=` deep-link).
- **`src/main.tsx` rewritten** with provider stack: QueryClient → BrowserRouter → AuthProvider → PreferencesProvider → SyncProvider → ToastProvider → App.
- **First `npx tsc --noEmit` run** produced ~20 errors; nearly all fixed (unused imports `Tag`/`useState`/`CardHeader`/`LocalInstallment`/`ScrollText`/`FileUp`/`Upload`/`useParams`; `lookups`/`currency` unused params; `Alert tone="success"|"danger"` → `"info"`; CreditCardsPage missing `useNavigate` import + `CardHeader`; InstallmentsPage broken `import ...lucide-react";import {` line; RecurringEditor TS2367 comparison; SearchPage `onChange`→`onValueChange`; DataSection; OverviewSection `UserProfile` fields).

### Active

"""Temporary local API server for a manual UI check. Deleted after use.

Runs against a throwaway SQLite file — the configured database is never touched.
"""

import os
import tempfile

os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "config.settings.dev")
os.environ.setdefault("SECRET_KEY", "local-ui-check")

import django  # noqa: E402

django.setup()

from django.conf import settings  # noqa: E402

# Hard override: never fall through to whatever DATABASE_URL is in `.env`.
settings.DATABASES = {
    "default": {
        "ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3",
        "NAME": os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "fintrack_ui_check.sqlite3"),
        "OPTIONS": {"timeout": 20},
    }
}
settings.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [
    "http://localhost:5173",
    "http://localhost:5174",
    "http://127.0.0.1:5174",
]
settings.CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS = settings.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment  # noqa: E402
from django.test.runner import DiscoverRunner  # noqa: E402

setup_test_environment()
DiscoverRunner(verbosity=0, interactive=False).setup_databases()

from django.core.management import call_command  # noqa: E402

print("serving api on http://localhost:8000 (sqlite)", flush=True)
call_command("runserver", "127.0.0.1:8000", use_reloader=False)

"""Temporary local API server for a manual UI check. Deleted after use.

DATABASE_URL is pinned to a throwaway SQLite file *before* Django reads its
settings, so the configured database can never be touched.
"""

import os
import tempfile

os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "config.settings.dev")
os.environ.setdefault("SECRET_KEY", "local-ui-check")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///" + os.path.join(
    tempfile.gettempdir(), "fintrack_ui_check.sqlite3"
)

import django  # noqa: E402

django.setup()

from django.conf import settings  # noqa: E402

settings.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [
    "http://localhost:5173",
    "http://localhost:5174",
    "http://127.0.0.1:5174",
]
settings.CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS = settings.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment  # noqa: E402
from django.test.runner import DiscoverRunner  # noqa: E402

setup_test_environment()
DiscoverRunner(verbosity=0, interactive=False).setup_databases()

from django.core.management import call_command  # noqa: E402

print("serving api on http://localhost:8000 (sqlite only)", flush=True)
call_command("runserver", "127.0.0.1:8000", use_reloader=False)

"""Per-user change log: model map and event helpers.

Kept apart from `views` so other layers (default data seeding, management
commands) can append to the same log the client pulls from.
"""

from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from uuid import UUID

from apps.finance import serializers as finance_serializers
from apps.finance.models import (
    Account,
    AccountGroup,
    Budget,
    Category,
    Debt,
    ExchangeRate,
    InstallmentPlan,
    RecurringRule,
    SavingsGoal,
    Tag,
    Transaction,
)

from .models import SyncEvent

ENTITY_MAP = {
    "account": Account,
    "account_group": AccountGroup,
    "budget": Budget,
    "category": Category,
    "debt": Debt,
    "exchange_rate": ExchangeRate,
    "installment": InstallmentPlan,
    "recurring": RecurringRule,
    "savings_goal": SavingsGoal,
    "tag": Tag,
    "transaction": Transaction,
}
# NOTE: attachments are intentionally absent. Binary uploads must go through
# POST /api/v1/attachments/upload/ (Cloudinary), which cannot be represented as a
# JSON mutation. The client caches attachments for offline viewing and only
# fetches them from the REST API when online.


def serializer_for(model):
    return getattr(finance_serializers, f"{model.__name__}Serializer")


def json_safe(value):
    """DRF leaves related pks as UUID objects; JSONField needs primitives."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {key: json_safe(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [json_safe(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, (UUID, Decimal)):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, (datetime, date)):
        return value.isoformat()
    return value


def record_event(user, entity, obj, op):
    """Append a change so `POST /sync/pull/` can replay it to clients.

    Pull streams *history*, not table state — a row that is never recorded here
    (seeded defaults, for example) would never reach the offline client.
    """
    payload = json_safe(dict(serializer_for(ENTITY_MAP[entity])(obj).data))
    payload["version"] = obj.version
    payload["deleted_at"] = obj.deleted_at.isoformat() if obj.deleted_at else None
    return SyncEvent.objects.create(
        user=user,
        entity=entity,
        entity_id=obj.id,
        version=obj.version,
        op=op,
        payload=payload,
    )

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build "FinTrack" (Personal Money Manager) — an offline-first personal-finance PWA (React+TS+Vite+Dexie frontend, Django+DRF backend, Neon PostgreSQL).
- Current task: complete the production UI/UX redesign in one shot — every page plus login/register — and integrate the frontend with the exact route architecture the user specified, adding/fixing any missing features in one undivided pass.

## Requirements
- Phase workflow: inspect → explain → implement → lightweight checks → inspect diff → report → stop. Do not auto-continue into unrelated phases; do not auto-commit/push.
- Prioritize implementation over exhaustive testing; only basic sanity checks (typecheck, build, lint).
- Do NOT run `python manage.py migrate` automatically; generate with `makemigrations`, user runs `migrate`.
- Do not rewrite working backend functionality; do not invent APIs. If a feature isn't implemented, prepare UI architecture without pretending it's functional.
- **Lucide React is the mandatory standard icon library** — no emoji UI, no hand-drawn SVGs, no other icon libs; centralized icon registry; `aria-label` on icon-only buttons; consistent stroke width and Tailwind sizing (`h-4/h-5/h-6`); semantic icon mapping; category icons stored as identifiers resolved via a registry — never render arbitrary user-provided components.
- Centralized design system with semantic tokens; no hardcoded colors in components; dark mode preserving semantic meaning; reduced-motion support; accessible forms/keyboard nav.
- Offline-first: React → state/query → Dexie/IndexedDB → sync queue → Django REST → Neon. Reports/budgets/calendar must work offline.
- Distinguish Income / Expense / Transfer semantically; never break accounting logic (transfer ≠ income/expense).
- No giant empty states ("No accounts yet." alone is forbidden — always icon + explanation + action).
- Desktop sidebar + mobile bottom nav with central "+" quick-add; responsive at 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920.
- Monorepo: `web/`, `api/`, `shared/`. Deploy: frontend→Vercel, backend→Render, DB→Neon, attachments→Cloudinary.
- No secrets in commits; never commit `.env`.
- **User's mandated route architecture (verbatim, must be honored):**
  - PUBLIC: `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password/:token`, `/verify-email`, `/mfa`
  - MAIN: `/` → redirect to `/overview`; `/overview`; `/accounts`, `/accounts/new`, `/accounts/:accountId`, `/accounts/:accountId/edit`; `/transactions`, `/transactions/new`, `/transactions/:transactionId`, `/transactions/:transactionId/edit`; `/categories`, `/categories/new`, `/categories/:categoryId/edit`; `/budgets`, `/budgets/new`, `/budgets/:budgetId`, `/budgets/:budgetId/edit`; `/statistics`; `/calendar`; `/goals`, `/goals/new`, `/goals/:goalId`, `/goals/:goalId/edit`; `/debts`, `/debts/new`, `/debts/:debtId`, `/debts/:debtId/edit`; `/credit-cards`, `/credit-cards/new`, `/credit-cards/:cardId`, `/credit-cards/:cardId/edit`; `/recurring`, `/recurring/new`, `/recurring/:recurringId`, `/recurring/:recurringId/edit`; `/installments`, `/installments/new`, `/installments/:installmentId`, `/installments/:installmentId/edit`; `/search`; `/bookmarks`; `/notifications`; `/sync/conflicts`
  - SETTINGS: `/settings`, `/settings/profile`, `/settings/security`, `/settings/appearance`, `/settings/notifications`, `/settings/currency`, `/settings/financial`, `/settings/sync`, `/settings/data`, `/settings/devices`, `/settings/about`
  - "integrate the frontend with these routes, if there are missing features fix and add it do it all in one task don't divide it"
- User asked: "change app.tsx also to the integration you've placed on the writing" — App.tsx must be rewritten to this route table.

## Decisions
- **Client-side analytics engine**: all report/statistics/budget/calendar/net-worth figures computed from Dexie via pure functions so offline reporting is real.
- `savings_goal` and `debt` nullable FKs on `Transaction` (migration `finance/0003_...`, generated not applied).
- Sync protocol: `M2M_FIELDS = {"transaction": {"tags": Tag}}`, `ALLOWED_FIELDS["transaction"]` includes `tags`, `recurring_id`, `installment_id`, `savings_goal_id`, `debt_id`; `FK_FIELDS` gained `recurring`, `installment`, `savings_goal`, `debt`.
- `LocalAttachment.blob: Blob | null`; attachments excluded from sync ENTITY_MAP (Cloudinary, online-only) by design.
- Preferences live in `meta` key `preferences` as one JSON blob — device-level.
- `useLocalData()` is the single read path: `useLiveQuery` per table + memoized `buildLookups()`.
- Tailwind palette stays CSS-variable-driven (`.cjs` config required; jiti caches config).
- Auth context owns full auth surface; router routes everything else.
- Auth screens use split-screen `AuthLayout` (branding panel only `lg`+).
- Money Manager philosophy over enterprise dashboard aesthetic; information-dense but calm, few large cards, progressive disclosure.
- `/` renders nothing and redirects to `/overview`; `isActive()` special-cases `/overview` instead of `/`.
- `/conflicts` renamed to `/sync/conflicts` per user architecture.
- Bottom nav = 4 primary items + central FAB (`grid-cols-5`, `z-40`); Statistics reachable via sidebar/drawer only; drawer is `z-50`.
- `PRIMARY_NAV` = Overview, Transactions, Accounts, Budget, Statistics; `PLANNING_NAV` = Goals, Debts, Credit cards, Recurring, Installments, Calendar; `ORGANISE_NAV` = Categories, Search, Bookmarks; `SETTINGS_ITEM` exported separately; `AUTH_ROUTES` + `isAuthRoute(pathname)`.
- `/categories/new` and `/categories/:categoryId/edit` are routed overlays — pattern repeated for all other `new`/`edit` sub-routes.
- `AccountDetailPage` and `AccountEditor` serve both `/accounts/:accountId` and `/credit-cards/:cardId` (params read via `accountId ?? cardId`); `AccountEditor` now also detects card section via `useLocation().pathname.startsWith("/credit-cards")` for close-targets and passes `defaultType="credit"` on `/credit-cards/new`.
- `AccountEditor` keys `AccountFormOverlay` by id so switching rows remounts.
- Debts page explicitly alerts that debts are not income/expense; repayments are transfers.
- Recurring rule pages project future occurrences locally via `advanceOccurrence()`.
- Design-system gaps fixed rather than worked around: `ProgressBar.className`, `Textarea.addon`, `Spinner`/`PageLoader` barrel exports; `SegmentedControl` has `size`/`className`/`ariaLabel`, `SegmentOption` has `icon?`/`tone?`; `Input` has no `suffix` — use `trailing`; `BadgeTone = neutral|primary|income|expense|warning|info` (**no `danger` or `success` — Alert shares this set**); UI `Charts.SeriesPoint = {label, value, secondary?, meta?}` (no `key`/`income`/`expense`/`net`); `SearchInput` prop is `onValueChange`.
- **`paramId()` helper** (`web/src/app/routeParams.ts`): `new` is a create route, not an id.
- **MFA**: LoginPage stashes `{email,password}` in sessionStorage (`fintrack_mfa_pending`) via `stashMfaCredentials()` and navigates to `/mfa`; `MfaPage` finishes sign-in and clears the stash.
- Notifications: REST-only resource cached in Dexie (`db.notifications`); device-level filters `notifyBudgets/Debts/Goals/Other` applied in NotificationsPage.
- **No `/fx/rates/` endpoint exists** — exchange rates are synced rows (`/exchange-rates/`); `CurrencySection` offers manual rate add/delete only.
- CSV export/import are real endpoints: `GET /transactions/export/`, `POST /transactions/import_csv/` with `{csv, dry_run}`.
- Settings layout = `SettingsPage` with sub-nav + `<Outlet />`; each section its own file; shared `Panel`/`ToggleRow` in `features/settings/Panel.tsx`.
- `ResetPasswordPage` reads `:token` from path params (falls back to `?token=`), `uid` still from query.
- Appearance "Motion" panel reads real `matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme...)")` / prefers-reduced-motion state.
- Deleted stale files: `src/App.test.tsx`, `src/sync/SyncStateBadge.tsx`.
- **Chart mapping**: StatisticsPage maps engine `SeriesPoint` → UI `SeriesPoint` via `flowSeries` (value=expense, secondary=income), `netSeries` (value=net), `worthSeries` (value=net worth).
- **Backend emails now send real links**: added `FRONTEND_URL` setting (`env("FRONTEND_URL", default="http://localhost:5173").rstrip("/")`) in `api/config/settings/base.py`; register → `{FRONTEND_URL}/verify-email?uid=..&token=..`, reset → `{FRONTEND_URL}/reset-password/{token}?uid=..`; both use `settings.DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL`. Documented in `.env.example`.
- **Account notes field removed from the form** — backend `Account` has no `notes` column, so the textarea was dead UI and was deleted (honest, no fake feature).
- **Account group select fixed**: was hardcoded names sent as `group_id` (invalid FK). Now loads real `db.account_groups` via `useLiveQuery`, has a "New group…" option backed by `createAccountGroup()`, group resolved before save in `submit()`.
- **Detail routes now linked from list pages**: added `onOpen` "Details" links on GoalsPage GoalCard, InstallmentsPage PlanCard; made BudgetsPage card label and DebtsPage counterparty clickable → detail routes. AccountDetailPage's Edit now navigates to `/accounts/:id/edit` (or `/credit-cards/:id/edit`) instead of opening a local overlay; `editorOpen` state and local `AccountFormOverlay` render removed.
- **PWA implemented**: `public/manifest.webmanifest` (id/scope `/`, standalone, shortcuts to `/transactions/new`, `/transactions`, `/overview`), `public/sw.js` (versioned caches `fintrack-shell-v1`, network-first navigation with `/index.html` fallback, cache-first hashed assets, cross-origin/API never cached, `SKIP_WAITING` message), `src/app/pwa.ts` (prod-only registration + `subscribeToUpdate` observable + `controllerchange` reload), `src/components/layout/NetworkBanner.tsx` (offline + update banners, `z-[45]`, `bottom-20 lg:bottom-4`, required copy "Offline — your changes are saved on this device and will sync automatically", shows `pendingCount` from `useSync`), `index.html` meta (manifest, theme-color light/dark, apple-mobile-web-app, viewport-fit=cover), `main.tsx` mounts `<NetworkBanner />` inside ToastProvider and calls `registerServiceWorker()`.
- **Icons generated from code**: `web/scripts/generate-icons.mjs` (pure Node zlib PNG encoder) → `public/icons/icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`, `maskable-512.png`, `apple-touch-icon.png`; Deep Emerald `#0F766E` plate, white ascending bars, Mint `#2DD4BF` coin; verified visually.

## Work State

### Completed
- **Phases 1–5 (earlier)**: scaffold/CI, users+audit apps, 11 finance models + services + ViewSets, Dexie schema/repositories/auth stub/routes, full sync engine, conflicts page, themed Tailwind config.
- **Backend full pass**: MFA, ProfileView, ChangePasswordView, session revocation, `purge_user`, TOTP, attachments (Cloudinary), notifications, recurring/installment generation, budgets, FX, all reports, CSV import/export, django-q2 jobs, management commands, admin, sanitized `.env.example`; RegisterSerializer `full_name`/`preferred_currency` fix; **email links now use `FRONTEND_URL`**.
- **Redesign Phases A–C**: design system (`lucide-react`, `dexie-react-hooks`, `index.css` tokens + dark overrides, `tailwind.config.cjs`, `design/icons.ts`, `design/format.ts`, `components/ui/*`); data layer + analytics (`db/*`, `sync/mapping.ts`, `features/analytics/*`, `features/settings/preferences.ts`, `app/navigation.ts`, SyncIndicator, ThemeToggle, AppShell); auth (AuthContext full surface + `profileName()`, AuthLayout, LoginPage, RegisterPage, ForgotPasswordPage, ResetPasswordPage, VerifyEmailPage, MfaPage).
- **All feature pages written** (TransactionList/Form/Editor/QuickAddSheet, OverviewPage, Accounts*/AccountEditor, TransactionsPage, TransactionDetailPage, CategoriesPage/CategoryEditor, ConflictsPage, Budget*, Goal*, Debt*, CreditCardsPage, Recurring*, Installment*, StatisticsPage, CalendarPage, SearchPage, BookmarksPage, NotificationsPage) and **all 11 settings files**.
- **`app/routeParams.ts`** wired into every routed editor.
- **`src/App.tsx` rewritten** to the mandated route table; `src/main.tsx` provider stack (QueryClient → BrowserRouter → AuthProvider → PreferencesProvider → SyncProvider → ToastProvider → App + NetworkBanner).
- **Typecheck clean**: `npx tsc --noEmit` passes.
- **Lint clean**: `npm run lint` passes (fixed Primitives `Card as` unused prop removal; `format.ts` `no-useless-escape`; removed `/* eslint-env */` from `sw.js`).
- **Build passes**: `npm run build` (tsc + vite) succeeds — 2045 modules, ~690 kB JS / 42.9 kB CSS, chunk-size warning only.
- **PWA complete**: manifest, service worker, registration/update flow, generated PNG icons, index.html meta, offline/update banner.
- **Route reachability gaps closed**: `/goals/:id`, `/budgets/:id`, `/debts/:id`, `/installments/:id` now linked from list pages; `/accounts/:id/edit` and `/credit-cards/:id/edit` linked from detail pages; `/credit-cards/new` defaults to `credit` type and returns to `/credit-cards`.
- **Account form bugs fixed**: dead Notes textarea removed; group select now uses real ids + inline group creation.

### Active
- **AccountsPage still opens its editor locally** (`editorOpen`/`editing` state, `?new=1` deep link, inline `<AccountFormOverlay>` at line ~244, `openCreate()`/`openEdit()` helpers, import at line 42) — should be converted to `navigate("/accounts/new")` and `navigate(\`/accounts/${id}/edit\`)` so the mandated routes are the real integration. OverviewPage / other callers using `/accounts?new=1` must be switched to `/accounts/new`.
- After that: re-run `tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Convert AccountsPage to routed editing: delete `editorOpen`/`editing`/`wantNew` effect and the inline `<AccountFormOverlay>`, change `openCreate()` → `navigate("/accounts/new")`, `openEdit(account)` → `navigate(\`/accounts/${account.id}/edit\`)`, remove the now-unused `AccountFormOverlay` import/state; grep for remaining `/accounts?new=1` links (OverviewPage empty state) and point them at `/accounts/new`.
2. Re-run `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build` in `web/`; fix fallout.
3. Verify remaining mandated routes are reachable/navigable (e.g. `/transactions/:transactionId` from TransactionList, `/transactions/new` from TransactionsPage header, `/categories/:categoryId/edit` from CategoriesPage rows) and wire any still-missing links.
4. Run `api/_smoke_all.py` once more on SQLite to verify sync M2M/FK additions **and the new RegisterSerializer fields + FRONTEND_URL email links**, then delete the throwaway script.
5. Remind the user to run `python manage.py migrate` in `api/` (pending migrations incl. new `finance/0003`; not applied by design).

## Relevant Files
- `web/src/App.tsx`: full route table — verify against mandated architecture.
- `web/src/main.tsx`: provider stack + NetworkBanner + `registerServiceWorker()`.
- `web/src/features/accounts/AccountsPage.tsx`: **still uses local editor overlay — next change target**.
- `web/src/features/accounts/AccountEditor.tsx`, `AccountFormOverlay.tsx`: routed editor + form (group select rewritten, `defaultType` prop added).

+class RefreshSerializer(TokenRefreshSerializer):
+    """Refresh tokens can outlive their account.

+    simplejwt's `validate()` does a bare `User.objects.get()`, so a token that

Is that a bug to fix? Consider: user A signs out, user B signs in on the same browser → user B sees user A's accounts/transactions until sync overwrites... Actually pull only adds/updates rows it receives; user B's pull brings B's rows, but A's rows remain (Dexie isn't scoped per user). So B sees A's data. That's a real privacy/correctness bug.

The right fix: clear local data when the signed-in account changes (or on sign-out).

But careful — "offline-first": if we clear on sign-out, a user who signs out then signs in again while offline would have no data. That's the classic trade-off. Most apps scope the local DB per account (e.g., prefix tables with the user id) rather than clearing.

A pragmatic fix: on auth change, if the new `accountKey` differs from the stored one, wipe local data (accounts, outbox, conflicts, checkpoint) before syncing. Store `last_account` in `meta`.
